purpose: Require an opposing signed intrinsic transition on the same transported raw surface before persistent local display risk can be seeded.

interpretation.conclusion: Same-surface signed opposition breaks the previous ghosting/WCAG/weak-flash tradeoff: multiple mode-8 candidates clear to 5% in 66.7 ms, pass both WCAG gates, retain low pan error, and reach weak-flash reduction up to about 0.792. The only remaining primary failure is moving-flash reduction, which is nearly invariant at about 0.372 across risk lifetime, gain, opposition threshold, and prime-tau probes. That flat response localizes the next investigation to current moving-event recognition/localization rather than persistent memory or mitigation strength.
